steps.title: Analyze and Prepare Launch Loader Feature
steps.description: Design an elegant launch loading overlay that integrates seamlessly with the 3D retro pocket calculator theme.

steps.title: Create Missing dialog_history.xml Resource
steps.description: Generate dialog_history.xml to layout the calculation logs, history views, and clear buttons to resolve compilation issues.

steps.title: Restructure activity_main.xml with FrameLayout Root
steps.description: Wrap activity_main.xml in a FrameLayout and place a clean, responsive launch loader overlay layout containing a neon green progress bar.

steps.title: Implement Launch Overlay Controller
steps.description: Incorporate Handler delay logic inside MainActivity's onCreate to automatically dismiss the initialization splash after exactly 2 seconds.

steps.title: Prune Gradle Third Party Dependencies
steps.description: Remove unnecessary implementation dependencies like org.nanohttpd inside app/build.gradle to ensure pristine native building.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Namespace Configuration
steps.description: Double check that AndroidManifest.xml correctly implements the standard android namespace schema to prevent any manifest parsing errors.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the modified, robust project with retro visual loader overlay and fully fixed dialog resources.
